top_signals.title: Anwar Avoids Coalition Turmoil as Key Party Stays in Cabinet
top_signals.summary: Malaysia’s Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim won a rare political reprieve over the weekend, after a string of electoral setbacks and turmoil within his own party, as the biggest component of his ruling coalition voted to stay in cabinet.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: First Gen Falls by Record 19% After Parent Rejected KKR Offer
top_signals.summary: Shares of First Gen Corp., one of the Philippines’ largest renewable energy companies, fell by a record on Monday after its parent turned down an offer from KKR to buy additional shares and take it private.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
